summary: Guarded audio-side initialization and delegated computation. Reads the object pointer stored at this+0x58 (dword index 22). If that pointer is non-null and the dword at byte offset +16 of the pointed structure is non-null, performs a one-time registration via OneTimeInitializationWithAtexitStyleRegistration (0x00404FE0) and returns the result of ShortComputation_7e10 (0x00407E10) invoked with three local byte buffers. Otherwise returns the stored this+0x58 pointer unchanged. Called from F_3DSoundPositioningUpdate (0x00405B90).

operations.description: result = this[22], i.e. the dword at byte offset 0x58; the stored pointer is also the return value when the guarded path is not taken.
Guard: the dword at byte offset +16 of the pointed structure must be non-null.
Call OneTimeInitializationWithAtexitStyleRegistration (0x00404FE0) for the one-time registration step.
Delegate the computation to ShortComputation_7e10 (0x00407E10), passing three local byte buffers (v2, v3, v4), and propagate its return value as the function result.
Return this+0x58 unchanged when either guard fails; otherwise return the result of ShortComputation_7e10.
Called from F_3DSoundPositioningUpdate (0x00405B90) (legacy ABI lead: Short_Computation_406100).
